entries.en: We listened to Shanti during the long drive home.
entries.zh: 我们在漫长的驾车归途中听了专辑《亮丽人生》。

entries.en: Nowak found a tiny brass key beneath the kitchen mat.
entries.zh: 诺瓦克在厨房的垫子下面发现了一把小黄铜钥匙。

entries.en: Bischoff carried the empty picture frame upstairs without touching its cracked glass.
entries.zh: 比肖夫把那个没装画的画框搬上楼，没有碰到破裂的玻璃。

entries.en: The photograph of Taliesin had faded along the edge nearest the window.
entries.zh: 那张塔里辛住宅的照片靠窗的一边已经褪色了。

entries.en: Mendez returned for the umbrella left behind after yesterday's meeting.
entries.zh: 门德斯回来取昨天开会后落下的雨伞。

entries.en: Hrawi placed a saucer beneath the dripping flowerpot.
entries.zh: 赫拉维把一个碟子放在滴水的花盆下面。

entries.en: Saleh stayed near the entrance so that late guests could find our table.
entries.zh: 萨利赫留在入口附近，好让迟到的客人能找到我们的桌子。

entries.en: Deana wrapped the little mirror in a scarf before packing it.
entries.zh: 德亚娜在打包前，先用一条围巾包好了那面小镜子。

entries.en: A sudden gust scattered the receipts that Ibanez had spread across the bench.
entries.zh: 一阵突如其来的风吹散了伊巴涅斯铺在长椅上的收据。

entries.en: The intern compared two old FDDI diagrams before filing the network records.
entries.zh: 实习生先比较了两张旧的光纤分布式数据接口图，再将网络记录归档。

entries.en: Strach listened for footsteps while the others searched the empty cellar.
entries.zh: 其他人搜查空地窖时，施特拉赫留心听着脚步声。

entries.en: Corden noticed that the parcel was heavier than the delivery note suggested.
entries.zh: 科登注意到那个包裹比送货单所显示的要重。

entries.en: Partido exchanged the broken chair for one with a firm wooden seat.
entries.zh: 帕蒂多把坏椅子换成了一把木质座面结实的椅子。

entries.en: Barro waited for the paint to dry before replacing the drawer handles.
entries.zh: 巴罗等油漆干了，才把抽屉把手装回去。

entries.en: Branwell could hear the kettle from the far end of the garden.
entries.zh: 布兰韦尔在花园的另一头也能听到水壶的声音。

entries.en: Svend rolled the damp map loosely instead of folding it.
entries.zh: 斯文把潮湿的地图松松地卷了起来，没有折叠。

entries.en: Macca pulled the curtains apart to let the afternoon light reach the desk.
entries.zh: 马卡拉开窗帘，让午后的阳光照到书桌上。

entries.en: The detective in the story mistakes a passing cyclist for the escaped crim.
entries.zh: 故事中的侦探误把一个路过的骑车人当成了逃犯。

entries.en: Tuckett reached the platform just as the station clock struck noon.
entries.zh: 车站的钟敲响正午时，塔克特刚好走到站台上。

entries.en: Masha saved a corner of the table for the unfinished jigsaw puzzle.
entries.zh: 玛莎在桌子的一角留出地方，放那幅尚未拼完的拼图。

entries.en: Krenz discovered a pencilled address on the back of the photograph.
entries.zh: 克伦茨在照片背面发现了一个用铅笔写的地址。

entries.en: The orientalist found a loose drawing inside the manuscript.
entries.zh: 那位东方学者在手稿中发现了一张散页画稿。

entries.en: Billingsley lowered the music when the telephone began to ring.
entries.zh: 电话响起来时，比林斯利调低了音乐的音量。

entries.en: She finished her sketch of Gandalf before the library closed.
entries.zh: 她在图书馆关门前完成了那幅甘道夫的素描。

entries.en: Rochefort held the ladder steady while I retrieved the box.
entries.zh: 我取回箱子时，罗什福尔扶稳了梯子。

entries.en: Filmer chose the smaller suitcase because the larger one had a broken wheel.
entries.zh: 菲尔默选了较小的行李箱，因为较大的那个坏了一个轮子。

entries.en: Callahan brought an extra pair of gloves for whoever forgot theirs.
entries.zh: 卡拉汉多带了一副手套，给忘带手套的人用。

entries.en: Matta moved her sewing basket away from the open window.
entries.zh: 玛塔把她的针线篮从开着的窗户旁移开了。

entries.en: Morey divided the remaining cake into four unequal pieces.
entries.zh: 莫里把剩下的蛋糕分成了大小不等的四块。

entries.meaningZh: 印度行政长官〔历史称谓〕
entries.en: In the novel, the nawab receives a petition during a private dinner.
entries.zh: 小说中，那位印度行政长官在一次私人晚餐期间收到了一份请愿书。

entries.en: Leonore squeezed the last drops of water from her gloves.
entries.zh: 利奥诺挤出了手套里剩下的最后几滴水。

entries.en: Darnell put the shopping bags down to unlock the back door.
entries.zh: 达内尔放下购物袋，去开后门的锁。

entries.en: Claudine shared her umbrella with a neighbour at the bus stop.
entries.zh: 克劳丁在公交车站与一位邻居合撑她的雨伞。

entries.en: Berenice repaired the torn pocket with thread from an old sewing kit.
entries.zh: 贝蕾妮斯用一个旧针线包里的线补好了破口袋。

entries.en: Pilger left his muddy boots outside the newly cleaned room.
entries.zh: 皮尔格把沾满泥的靴子留在了刚打扫过的房间外。

entries.en: Mrs Oglethorpe lent us a folding table for the afternoon charity sale.
entries.zh: 奥格尔索普太太借给我们一张折叠桌，供下午的义卖使用。

entries.en: After such a large dinner, my kyte could hold no more.
entries.zh: 吃了这么丰盛的一顿晚餐后，我的肚子再也装不下东西了。

entries.en: Kinghorn searched every coat pocket before finding the ticket in a book.
entries.zh: 金霍恩找遍了所有外套口袋，最后在一本书里找到了票。

entries.en: Dickon carried the sleeping puppy in a basket lined with towels.
entries.zh: 迪肯用一个铺着毛巾的篮子抱着熟睡的小狗。

entries.en: Diggory tested the gate twice to make sure the latch caught.
entries.zh: 迪戈里试了两次大门，确保门闩能扣住。

entries.en: Penda opened the cupboard slowly to avoid waking the baby.
entries.zh: 彭达慢慢打开橱柜，以免吵醒婴儿。

entries.en: Yassir caught the rolling apple before it reached the stairs.
entries.zh: 亚西尔在苹果滚到楼梯前接住了它。

entries.en: Her report included cGMP measurements but omitted the dates of collection.
entries.zh: 她的报告列出了环鸟苷酸的测量数据，却漏掉了采集日期。

entries.en: Shekhar balanced a bowl of soup on the crowded tray.
entries.zh: 谢卡尔在那个放满东西的托盘上稳稳地放着一碗汤。

entries.en: In the story, an auspex watches the birds while a messenger waits nearby.
entries.zh: 故事中，一名鸟卜者观察着鸟，一名信使在附近等候。

entries.en: The old SNMP manual was missing several pages near the end.
entries.zh: 那本旧的简单网络管理协议手册临近结尾处缺了几页。

entries.en: Jabir pushed the loose nail back into the fence with a hammer.
entries.zh: 贾比尔用锤子把松动的钉子敲回栅栏里。

entries.en: Ershad set the alarm earlier because the first bus often filled up.
entries.zh: 艾尔沙德把闹钟调早了，因为首班公交车经常坐满。

entries.en: The team postponed its microkernel redesign until the missing documentation arrived.
entries.zh: 团队暂缓微内核的重新设计，直到缺失的文档送达。

entries.en: We compared photographs of fish assigned to the genus Rasbora.
entries.zh: 我们比较了几张被归入波鱼属的鱼的照片。

entries.en: Danziger removed a stone from the shoe before continuing along the path.
entries.zh: 丹齐格取出鞋里的一颗石子后，继续沿着小路走。

entries.en: The postcard from Berdichev arrived inside an envelope with no return address.
entries.zh: 那张来自别尔季切夫的明信片装在一个没有回邮地址的信封里寄来了。

entries.en: My friend borrowed a book about Basquiat for her evening class.
entries.zh: 我的朋友为了晚上的课借了一本关于巴斯奎特的书。

entries.en: The parcel from Yarm contained a hand-knitted scarf.
entries.zh: 那个从亚姆寄来的包裹里装着一条手工编织的围巾。

entries.meaningZh: 布伦熊〔《列那狐传奇》中的角色〕
entries.en: The children chose a softer pencil for their drawing of Bruin from the Reynard stories.
entries.zh: 孩子们选了一支较软的铅笔，来画《列那狐传奇》中的布伦熊。

entries.en: She kept the envelope from Altdorf because of its unusual stamp.
entries.zh: 她因为那枚特别的邮票，保留了那个从阿尔道夫寄来的信封。

entries.en: McKendrick kept the torn receipt in case the shop asked for it.
entries.zh: 麦肯德里克保留了那张撕破的收据，以备商店索要。

entries.en: Gerstner checked the cupboard after noticing an unfamiliar smell.
entries.zh: 格斯特纳闻到一股陌生的气味后，检查了橱柜。

entries.en: Dwayne tightened the cap before putting the bottle into his bag.
entries.zh: 德韦恩拧紧瓶盖，才把瓶子放进自己的包里。

entries.meaningZh: 驼毛短外衣〔波斯服饰旧称 barak〕
entries.en: The costume designer chose a camel-hair barak coat for the historical scene.
entries.zh: 服装设计师为那场历史戏选了一件驼毛短外衣。

entries.en: Our discussion began with an old photograph of the island of Raasay.
entries.zh: 我们的讨论从一张拉赛岛的旧照片开始。

entries.en: Fleischmann marked the uneven step with a strip of bright tape.
entries.zh: 弗莱施曼用一条鲜艳的胶带标出了那级不平整的台阶。

entries.en: Sien fetched a longer cable when the lamp would not reach the desk.
entries.zh: 灯的电线够不到书桌时，暹取来了一根更长的电缆。

entries.en: A loose page slipped from the book about Schleiermacher onto my lap.
entries.zh: 关于施莱尔马赫的那本书里滑出一张散页，落在了我的膝上。

entries.en: The charman swept the back stairs before the office opened.
entries.zh: 办公室开门前，那名男杂役扫了后面的楼梯。

entries.en: The farmer brought a Duroc into the empty pen beside the barn.
entries.zh: 农场主把一头杜洛克猪带进了谷仓旁的空猪栏。

entries.en: Jamila placed the warm loaf on a rack beside the stove.
entries.zh: 杰米拉把温热的面包放在炉子旁的架子上。

entries.en: Freemantle repaired the strap rather than throw away the whole bag.
entries.zh: 弗里曼特尔修好了背带，没有扔掉整个包。

entries.en: Ferdi tried the spare key after the original snapped in the lock.
entries.zh: 原来的钥匙断在锁里后，费尔迪试了试备用钥匙。

entries.en: Redburn had to move the bicycle before the delivery van could enter.
entries.zh: 雷德本不得不先把自行车移开，送货车才能开进来。

entries.en: Morpurgo found enough dry wood beneath the shelter for a small fire.
entries.zh: 莫珀戈在棚子下面找到了足够生一小堆火的干木柴。

entries.en: Dungarvan caught the falling cup but spilled its contents across the desk.
entries.zh: 邓加文接住了掉下来的杯子，但杯里的东西洒了一桌。

entries.en: Bissett washed the paintbrushes while the others covered the floor.
entries.zh: 其他人遮盖地板时，比塞特清洗了画笔。

entries.en: Rhee paused in the doorway to shake the snow from a coat.
entries.zh: 李在门口停下来，抖掉了一件外套上的雪。

entries.en: Slocombe offered to collect the chairs after the concert.
entries.zh: 索坎比提出在音乐会结束后帮忙收椅子。

entries.en: Castelnau noticed a small tear along the lining of the borrowed jacket.
entries.zh: 卡斯泰尔诺注意到借来的夹克衬里有一道小裂口。

entries.en: Schramm folded the blanket lengthwise to fit it into the narrow drawer.
entries.zh: 施拉姆沿长边把毯子折起，好放进狭窄的抽屉里。

entries.en: Rickie could not find the remote control until the cushions were removed.
entries.zh: 直到坐垫被拿开后，瑞奇才找到了遥控器。

entries.en: The baker set aside some maslin for a small loaf.
entries.zh: 面包师留出一些混合粉，准备做一条小面包。

entries.en: Malc drew the route on a napkin because no map was available.
entries.zh: 因为找不到地图，马尔茨把路线画在了一张餐巾纸上。

entries.en: Kadhafi set the tray down before answering the knock at the door.
entries.zh: 卡扎菲先放下托盘，再去应门。

entries.en: An old photograph from Ossetia fell out of the travel journal.
entries.zh: 一本旅行日记里掉出了一张来自奥塞梯的旧照片。

entries.en: The class returned to its discussion of the Hsia dynasty after a short break.
entries.zh: 短暂休息后，全班又继续讨论夏朝。

entries.en: Kimon held a torch while we looked beneath the stalled car.
entries.zh: 我们查看熄火的汽车底部时，基蒙举着手电筒。

entries.en: Spatz collected the empty bottles in a crate behind the counter.
entries.zh: 施帕茨把空瓶子收进柜台后面的一个板条箱里。

entries.en: McNealy brushed the sand from the picnic blanket before folding it.
entries.zh: 麦克尼利先掸掉野餐毯上的沙子，再把它折起来。

entries.en: The seminar left little time for our discussion of Nietzschean ideas.
entries.zh: 研讨会留给我们讨论尼采哲学思想的时间很少。

entries.en: Ryker made room on the shelf by stacking the smaller bowls.
entries.zh: 赖克把较小的碗摞起来，在架子上腾出了地方。

entries.en: Lepine borrowed a sheet of paper to leave a note for the caretaker.
entries.zh: 勒平借了一张纸，准备给管理员留张便条。

entries.en: Furby placed the cracked cup on the windowsill instead of using it.
entries.zh: 弗比把有裂纹的杯子放在窗台上，没有拿来用。

entries.en: Aplin put the ladder away after checking the gutter.
entries.zh: 阿普林检查完排水槽后，把梯子收好了。

entries.meaningZh: 粗鲁的澳大利亚人〔澳大利亚俚语，贬义〕
entries.en: The film portrays him as an ocker who mocks everyone else's manners.
entries.zh: 电影把他塑造成一个嘲笑别人举止的粗鲁澳大利亚人。

entries.meaningZh: 镁灰岩〔旧地质用语，限本例的 Zechstein limestone〕
entries.en: The illustrator sketched an old specimen of Zechstein limestone for the archive.
entries.zh: 插画师为档案绘制了一块旧镁灰岩标本的素描。

entries.en: Vecchi handed the cashier a handful of coins and waited for the change.
entries.zh: 韦基递给收银员一把硬币，等着找零。

entries.en: Britta covered her wet hair with a towel before opening the door.
entries.zh: 布丽塔用毛巾裹住湿头发，然后打开了门。

entries.en: Hannele rescued the shopping list from a puddle near the gate.
entries.zh: 汉内莱从大门附近的一个水坑里捞出了购物清单。

entries.en: During the lecture, she compared two images of Sycorax.
entries.zh: 讲座期间，她比较了两张天卫十七的图像。

entries.en: Rosalba searched her bag for a pen while the receptionist waited.
entries.zh: 接待员等候时，罗萨尔芭在自己的包里找笔。

entries.en: Nour caught sight of the missing dog through a gap in the fence.
entries.zh: 努尔透过栅栏的一道缝隙，看到了那只走失的狗。

entries.en: She sketched specimens of Ixora for the botanical drawing class.
entries.zh: 她为植物绘画课描绘了龙船花属的植物标本。

entries.en: Erlich fastened the suitcase with a strap because its zip was broken.
entries.zh: 埃尔利赫用一条带子扎紧了行李箱，因为拉链坏了。

entries.meaningZh: 责骂〔苏格兰及英格兰北部方言〕
entries.en: The old neighbour would flyte the children whenever their ball struck his fence.
entries.zh: 那些孩子的球一打到他的栅栏上，那位年老的邻居就会责骂他们。

entries.en: The student slipped a bookmark into the chapter about Babur.
entries.zh: 学生在介绍巴布尔的那一章里夹入了一张书签。

entries.en: Alina slipped her cold hands into the pockets of her coat.
entries.zh: 爱丽娜把冰冷的双手插进了自己的外套口袋里。

entries.en: Masud returned the borrowed drill with a new set of bits.
entries.zh: 马苏德归还借来的电钻时，还附上了一套新的钻头。

entries.en: Xanthe replaced the wilted flowers with a bowl of bright oranges.
entries.zh: 赞茜撤掉了枯萎的花，换上了一碗鲜亮的橙子。

entries.en: Mr Sakata helped us lift the heavy trunk onto the trolley.
entries.zh: 坂田先生帮我们把沉重的箱子抬到了手推车上。

entries.en: At the seminar, she compared two accounts of the Nogai.
entries.zh: 研讨会上，她比较了两份关于诺盖族的记述。

entries.en: Feetham found a handwritten recipe tucked inside the old cookbook.
entries.zh: 菲瑟姆发现那本旧食谱里夹着一张手写的菜谱。

entries.en: The revised report included the DNase assay results that the first version had omitted.
entries.zh: 修订后的报告补入了初稿遗漏的脱氧核糖核酸酶检测结果。

entries.en: She lifted the sukey off the stove before setting out the cups.
entries.zh: 她把茶水壶从炉子上提下来，才摆出杯子。

entries.en: Inder borrowed a stool to reach the boxes above the wardrobe.
entries.zh: 因德尔借了一把凳子，好够到衣柜上方的箱子。

entries.en: The museum lent our class an illustrated book about the Tokugawa family.
entries.zh: 博物馆借给我们班一本介绍德川家族的插图书。

entries.en: Horatia tied a bright ribbon around her suitcase handle.
entries.zh: 霍雷希亚在自己的行李箱把手上系了一条鲜艳的丝带。

entries.en: The lecturer paused beside the projected portrait of Aurangzeb.
entries.zh: 讲师在投映的奥朗则布肖像旁停了下来。

entries.en: Pasa moved her chair closer to the lamp to mend a sleeve.
entries.zh: 帕莎把椅子移到更靠近灯的地方，准备补一只衣袖。

entries.en: Moscovici traced the water leak to a loose joint beneath the sink.
entries.zh: 莫斯科维奇查出，漏水是洗涤槽下面的一个接头松动造成的。

entries.en: Dadda lowered the blind when sunlight began to fall across the screen.
entries.zh: 阳光开始照到屏幕上时，达达放下了百叶窗。

entries.en: Yussuf gathered the scattered chess pieces before the cleaners arrived.
entries.zh: 清洁人员到来前，优素福收起了散落的棋子。

entries.en: Madra brought the youngest child a cushion so the table would be within reach.
entries.zh: 马德拉给最小的孩子拿来一个坐垫，好让孩子够得到桌子。

entries.en: We watched Amelie after dinner and discussed it on the walk home.
entries.zh: 我们晚饭后看了电影《天使爱美丽》，在步行回家的路上讨论了它。

entries.en: The lecturer replaced the blurred illustration of Zoser with a clearer one.
entries.zh: 讲师把那幅模糊的左赛尔插图换成了一幅更清晰的。

entries.en: The letter from Samana contained a photograph wrapped in thin paper.
entries.zh: 那封从萨马纳寄来的信里放着一张用薄纸包着的照片。

entries.en: Mallia wiped the rain from the bicycle seat with an old cloth.
entries.zh: 马利亚用一块旧布擦掉了自行车座上的雨水。

entries.en: Diniz noticed the loose floorboard when a coin rolled beneath it.
entries.zh: 一枚硬币滚到地板下面时，迪尼斯注意到了那块松动的地板。

entries.en: Cusick filled the watering can before carrying it to the balcony.
entries.zh: 卡西克装满了洒水壶，然后把它提到阳台上。

entries.en: Cinzia turned the cushion over to hide the small coffee stain.
entries.zh: 钦齐亚把坐垫翻了个面，遮住那小块咖啡渍。

entries.en: Andrus carried his packed lunch in a box that barely fitted his bag.
entries.zh: 安德勒斯用一个几乎放不进包的盒子带着自己的午餐。

entries.en: The archivist put the Tyron swatch beside the other historical rayon samples.
entries.zh: 档案管理员把那块泰纶样布放在其他历史人造丝样本旁。

entries.en: Surkov kept the empty seat beside the aisle for a late arrival.
entries.zh: 苏尔科夫把过道旁的空座位留给了一个迟到的人。

entries.en: Sanson offered a dry pair of socks to the visitor with wet shoes.
entries.zh: 桑松表示可以给那位鞋子湿了的访客一双干袜子。

entries.en: Guntram measured the doorway before agreeing to move the piano.
entries.zh: 贡特拉姆先量了门口的尺寸，才同意搬钢琴。

entries.en: Gassendi found a missing button among the coins in a coat pocket.
entries.zh: 伽桑狄在一个外套口袋的硬币中找到了丢失的纽扣。

entries.en: Floy placed the clean sheets on the bed and opened the window.
entries.zh: 弗洛伊把干净的床单放到床上，打开了窗户。

entries.en: Eadwine waited beneath the awning until the heavy shower passed.
entries.zh: 埃德温在遮篷下面等到大雨过去。

entries.en: The reading group postponed its debate about Hobbesian political theory.
entries.zh: 读书小组推迟了关于霍布斯政治哲学理论的辩论。

entries.en: The editor asked for a shorter explanation of the essay's Marxian approach.
entries.zh: 编辑要求用更简短的文字解释文章所采用的马克思理论视角。

entries.en: Utterson closed the gate gently after the latch began to rattle.
entries.zh: 门闩开始作响后，厄特森轻轻关上了大门。

entries.en: Roxie found a quiet corner where the puppy could finish its meal.
entries.zh: 罗克西找到了一个安静的角落，让小狗能在那里吃完东西。

entries.en: Rodo lifted the rug to check whether the wooden floor was dry.
entries.zh: 罗多掀起地毯，查看木地板是否已经干了。

entries.en: Rilla used a folded newspaper to steady the wobbling table.
entries.zh: 里拉用一张折叠的报纸垫稳了摇晃的桌子。

entries.en: Ranald unrolled the sleeping bag to check for damp patches.
entries.zh: 拉纳尔德摊开睡袋，检查有没有潮湿的地方。

entries.en: Posi divided the seedlings between two trays before carrying them outside.
entries.zh: 波西把幼苗分装到两个托盘里，再拿到外面。

entries.en: She copied the weights in mounces from the old order into her notebook.
entries.zh: 她把旧订单上以公制两表示的重量抄进了笔记本。

entries.en: Molland caught a sleeve on the hook beside the door.
entries.zh: 莫兰的一只衣袖挂在了门旁的钩子上。

entries.en: Memet balanced the shopping bags on the bench while looking for a key.
entries.zh: 梅梅特找钥匙时，把几个购物袋稳稳地搁在长椅上。

entries.en: Mehmed pulled the loose thread carefully to avoid tearing the fabric.
entries.zh: 穆罕默德小心地拉那根松线，以免扯破布料。

entries.en: Lubor took the smaller path after noticing footprints in the mud.
entries.zh: 卢博尔注意到泥里的脚印后，走上了那条较小的小路。

entries.en: The architect imagined an Edenic courtyard beyond the noisy street.
entries.zh: 建筑师想象着在那条嘈杂街道的另一边，有一座伊甸园般的庭院。

entries.en: The cattle crowded into the kraal as the storm approached.
entries.zh: 暴风雨逼近时，牛群拥进了牛栏。

entries.en: She sorted the old Zairian stamps into a separate album.
entries.zh: 她把那些旧的扎伊尔邮票分放在另一本集邮册里。

entries.en: Izzie brought a spare apron because hers was still wet.
entries.zh: 伊兹带来了一条备用围裙，因为她自己的那条还湿着。

entries.en: Isay turned the music off to listen for the approaching delivery van.
entries.zh: 伊赛关掉音乐，留心听送货车驶近的声音。

entries.en: Fouchard carried the last crate inside before the rain started.
entries.zh: 福查德在下雨前把最后一个板条箱搬了进去。

entries.en: Clelia chose a seat near the door so she could leave quietly.
entries.zh: 克莱利亚选了一个靠门的座位，好悄悄离开。

entries.en: Bedelia made a small hole in the wrapping to see which box was hers.
entries.zh: 贝德莉娅在包装上开了一个小口，想看看哪个盒子是她的。

entries.en: An Apolline altar stands at the centre of the imagined temple.
entries.zh: 那座想象中的神庙中央立着一座阿波罗祭坛。

entries.en: Angy added another spoonful of sugar after tasting the sour berries.
entries.zh: 安吉尝了尝那些酸的浆果后，又加了一匙糖。

entries.en: A Cheviot stood beside the empty feeding trough.
entries.zh: 一只切维厄特绵羊站在空饲料槽旁。

entries.meaningZh: 国防军〔纳粹德国军事机构名〕
entries.en: The class discussed an old documentary about the Wehrmacht.
entries.zh: 全班讨论了一部关于纳粹德国国防军的旧纪录片。

entries.en: She lent us a collection of Argentinean short stories for the journey.
entries.zh: 她借给我们一本阿根廷短篇小说集，供旅途中阅读。

entries.en: Duckworth spread an old sheet beneath the chair before starting to paint.
entries.zh: 达克沃思在椅子下面铺了一条旧床单，然后开始刷漆。

entries.meaningZh: 残奥会的〔形容词，常用于 Paralympic Games〕
entries.en: The family watched an old recording of the Paralympic Games after dinner.
entries.zh: 晚饭后，这家人看了一段残奥会的旧录像。

entries.en: The tutor asked for a clearer introduction to the essay on Islamization.
entries.zh: 导师要求把那篇关于伊斯兰化的文章的引言写得更清楚。

entries.en: Her notes included a Euclidean diagram that had been drawn in red ink.
entries.zh: 她的笔记里有一幅用红墨水绘制的欧几里得几何图。

entries.en: The parcel from Accrington arrived with one corner badly crushed.
entries.zh: 那个从阿克林顿寄来的包裹送到时，有一个角已经被严重压坏了。

entries.en: An Ecuadorean novel lay open beside her unfinished cup of tea.
entries.zh: 一本厄瓜多尔小说摊开着，旁边是她还没喝完的茶。

entries.en: Beyond the ruined wall, an elysian garden appeared in her dream.
entries.zh: 梦中，那道残墙外出现了一座仙境般的花园。

entries.meaningZh: 贝尔格莱维亚〔伦敦地区名〕
entries.en: He found an old letter from Belgravia among the family photographs.
entries.zh: 他在家里的照片中找到了一封从贝尔格莱维亚寄来的旧信。

entries.en: The writer Christianized the old legend while retaining its central conflict.
entries.zh: 作者把那个古老传说基督教化，但保留了其中的核心冲突。

entries.en: Rushton opened the curtains just enough to see the narrow street below.
entries.zh: 拉什顿把窗帘拉开了一点，刚好能看见下面狭窄的街道。

entries.en: The mafioso in the screenplay refuses to speak while his lawyer is absent.
entries.zh: 剧本中的黑手党成员在律师不在场时拒绝开口。

entries.en: Russel removed his muddy shoes before stepping onto the new carpet.
entries.zh: 拉塞尔脱掉沾满泥的鞋，才踏上新地毯。

entries.en: The illustrator tried a different angle for her sketch of Don Quixote.
entries.zh: 插画师尝试从另一个角度画堂吉诃德的素描。

entries.meaningZh: 考尔菲尔德〔澳大利亚地名〕
entries.en: The postcard from Caulfield was tucked behind a photograph in the album.
entries.zh: 那张从考尔菲尔德寄来的明信片夹在相册里一张照片的后面。

entries.en: Bayley set a bucket beneath the water leak before calling the landlord.
entries.zh: 贝利在漏水处下面放了一个水桶，然后给房东打电话。

entries.en: Bathgate stayed behind to carry the folded chairs into the storeroom.
entries.zh: 巴思盖特留了下来，准备把折好的椅子搬进储藏室。

entries.en: Faversham held the basket open while we collected the fallen apples.
entries.zh: 我们捡落下的苹果时，法弗沙姆撑开了篮口。

entries.en: Ms Ewart lifted the lid carefully to avoid spilling the soup.
entries.zh: 尤尔特女士小心地揭开盖子，以免把汤洒出来。

entries.meaningZh: 留在台上〔拉丁语舞台指示〕
entries.en: The others leave; manet Julia, staring at the unopened letter.
entries.zh: 其他人退场；朱莉娅留在台上，盯着那封尚未拆开的信。

entries.en: The envelope from Fullerton contained a photograph and a short note.
entries.zh: 那个从富勒顿寄来的信封里装着一张照片和一张简短的便条。

entries.meaningZh: 示巴女王〔用于完整名称 Queen of Sheba〕
entries.en: Our group compared two illustrations of the Queen of Sheba in retellings of the biblical story.
entries.zh: 我们小组比较了两幅出现在《圣经》故事重述本中的示巴女王插图。

entries.en: Belgrave checked each pocket before putting the coat into the washing machine.
entries.zh: 贝尔格雷夫检查了每个口袋，然后把外套放进洗衣机。

entries.en: Jenkinson lowered the blind to keep the afternoon sun off the painting.
entries.zh: 詹金森放下百叶窗，以免午后的阳光照到那幅画上。

entries.en: The seminar ended before we could discuss the paper's Lockean framework.
entries.zh: 我们还没来得及讨论那篇论文的洛克哲学框架，研讨会就结束了。

entries.en: Shipley left a clean towel beside the basin for the next guest.
entries.zh: 希普利在洗手盆旁放了一条干净毛巾，给下一位客人用。

entries.en: Rigg carried the little table sideways through the narrow doorway.
entries.zh: 里格侧着把那张小桌子搬过了狭窄的门口。

entries.en: Blackman sorted the screws by size before assembling the shelf.
entries.zh: 布莱克曼先把螺丝按大小分好，再组装架子。

entries.en: Rendell pushed the loose tile back into place with one hand.
entries.zh: 伦德尔用一只手把松动的瓷砖推回原位。

entries.en: Mr Schultz lent us a cart for moving the bags of soil.
entries.zh: 舒尔茨先生借给我们一辆手推车，用来搬那几袋土。

entries.en: She used an old Blackstone annual report to practise reading financial tables.
entries.zh: 她用一份黑石集团的旧年报练习阅读财务表格。

entries.en: The catalogue included photographs of Bahian woodcarvings from a private collection.
entries.zh: 目录收录了私人藏品中巴伊亚木雕的照片。

entries.en: Ms Marin collected the unused tickets after everyone had taken a seat.
entries.zh: 大家都坐好后，马林女士收起了没用上的票。

entries.en: Dianne put her glasses beside the bed before turning out the light.
entries.zh: 黛安娜把眼镜放在床边，然后关了灯。

entries.meaningZh: 犹地亚的〔古地区名相关义〕
entries.en: The student compared two drawings of Judean pottery before beginning the essay.
entries.zh: 学生在开始写文章前，比较了两幅犹地亚陶器的图画。

entries.en: The tutor returned her essay on Christianization with several questions about its introduction.
entries.zh: 导师退回了她那篇关于基督教化的文章，对引言提了几个问题。

entries.en: Willem removed a tiny splinter from the edge of the wooden handle.
entries.zh: 威廉除去了木柄边缘的一根小木刺。

entries.en: A folded copy of Newsweek kept slipping from the overcrowded shelf.
entries.zh: 一本折过的《新闻周刊》总是从放得太满的架子上滑下来。
